mn101:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati; Devadahaṃ nāma Sakkānaṃ nigamo.
mn101:2.2: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn101:2.4: Santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃ-vādino evaṃ-diṭṭhino:
mn101:2.5: Yaṃ kiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti, sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, sabban taṃ pubbekatahetu;
mn101:2.6: iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā vyantibhāvā, navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā āyatiṃ anavassavo,
mn101:2.7: āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo, kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo, dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo, vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatīti. --
mn101:3.1: Evaṃ-vādāhaṃ, bhikkhave, Nigaṇṭhe upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadāmi:
mn101:3.2: Saccaṃ kira tumhe, āvuso Nigaṇṭhā, evaṃ vādino evaṃ-diṭṭhino:
mn101:3.3: Yaṃ kiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti, sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, sabban taṃ pubbekatahetu;
mn101:3.4: iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā vyantibhāvā, navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā, āyatiṃ anavassavo,
mn101:3.5: āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo, kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo, dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo,vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatīti?
mn101:3.6: Te ce me, bhikkhave, Nigaṇṭhā evaṃ puṭṭhā Āmā ti paṭijānanti,
mn101:4.2: Kiṃ pana tumhe, āvuso Nigaṇṭhā, jānātha:
mn101:4.3: Ahuvām' eva mayaṃ pubbe, na nāhuvamhāti?
mn101:4.5: Kiṃ pana tumhe, āvuso Nigaṇṭhā, jānātha:
mn101:4.6: Akarām' eva mayaṃ pubbe pāpaṃ kammaṃ, na nākaramhāti?
mn101:4.8: Kiṃ pana tumhe , āvuso Nigaṇṭhā, jānātha:
mn101:4.9: Evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā pāpaṃ kammaṃ akaramhāti?
mn101:4.11: Kiṃ pana tumhe, āvuso Nigaṇṭhā jānātha:
mn101:4.12: Ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ, ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjiretabbaṃ, ettakamhi vā dukkhe nijjiṇṇe sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatīti?
mn101:4.14: Kiṃ pana tumhe, āvuso Nigaṇṭhā, jānātha
mn101:4.15: diṭṭhe va dhamme akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadan ti?
mn101:5.1: Iti kira tumhe, āvuso Nigaṇṭhā, na jānātha:
mn101:5.2: Ahuvām' eva mayaṃ pubbe, na nāhuvamhāti; na jānātha:
mn101:5.3: Akarām' eva mayaṃ pubbe pāpaṃ kammaṃ, na nākaramāti; na jānātha:
mn101:5.4: Evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā pāpaṃ kammaṃ akaramhāti; na jānātha:
mn101:5.5: Ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ, ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjiretabbaṃ, ettakamhi vā dukkhe nijjiṇṇe sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatīti; na jānātha
mn101:5.6: diṭṭhe va dhamme akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadaṃ.
mn101:5.7: Evaṃ sante āyasmantānaṃ Nigaṇṭhānaṃ na kallaṃ assa veyyākaraṇāya:
mn101:5.8: Yaṃ kiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti, sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, sabban taṃ pubbekatahetu;
mn101:5.9: iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā vyantibhāvā, navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā, āyatiṃ anavassavo,
mn101:5.10: āyatiṃ anassavā kammakkhayo, kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo, dukhakkhayā vedanākkhayo, vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn101:6.2: Ahuvām' eva mayaṃ pubbe, na nāhuvamhāti, -- jāneyyātha:
mn101:6.3: Akarām' eva mayaṃ pubbe pāpaṃ kammaṃ, na nākaramhāti jāneyyātha:
mn101:6.4: Evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā pāpaṃ dhammaṃ akaramhāti: jāneyyātha:
mn101:6.5: Ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjiretabbaṃ, ettakamhi vā dukkhe nijjiṇṇe sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatīti; jāneyyātha
mn101:6.6: diṭṭhe va dhamme akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadaṃ.
mn101:6.7: Evaṃ sante āyasmantānaṃ Nigaṇṭhānaṃ kallaṃ assa veyyākaraṇāya,
mn101:6.8: yaṃ kiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti, sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, sabban taṃ pubbekatahetu;
mn101:6.9: iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā vyantibhāvā, navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā, āyatiṃ anavassavo,
mn101:6.10: āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo, kammakkhayyā dukkhakkhayo, dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo, vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatīti
mn101:7.1: Seyyathāpi, āvuso Nigaṇṭhā, puriso sallena viddho assa savīsena gāḷhūpalepanena;
mn101:7.2: so sallassa pi vedanāhetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyeyya;
mn101:7.3: tassa mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ upaṭṭhapeyyum;
mn101:7.4: tassa so bhisakko sallakatto satthena vaṇamukhaṃ parikanteyya;
mn101:7.5: so satthena pi vaṇamukhassa parikantanahetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyeyya;
mn101:7.6: tassa so bhisakko sallakatto esaniyā sallaṃ eseyya;
mn101:7.7: so esaniyā pi sallassa esanāhetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyeyya;
mn101:7.8: tassa so bhisakko sallakatto sallaṃ abbyaheyya;
mn101:7.9: so sallassa pi abbyahanahetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyeyya;
mn101:7.10: tassa so bhisakko sallakatto agadaṅgāraṃ vaṇamukhe odaheyya;
mn101:7.11: so agadaṅgārassa pi vaṇamukhe odahanahetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyeyya;
mn101:7.12: so aparena samayena rūḷhena vaṇena saṃchavinā arogo assa sukhī serī sayaṃvasī yena kāmaṅgamo;
mn101:7.14: Ahaṃ ko pubbe viddho ahosiṃ savīsena gāḷhūpalepanena;
mn101:7.15: so 'haṃ sallassa pi vedanāhetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyiṃ;
mn101:7.16: tassa me mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ upaṭṭhapesuṃ;
mn101:7.17: tassa me so bhisakko sallakatto satthena vaṇamukhaṃ parikanti;
mn101:7.18: so 'haṃ sallena pi vaṇamukhassa parikantanahetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyiṃ;
mn101:7.19: tassa me so bhisakko sallakatto esaniyā sallaṃ esi;
mn101:7.20: so 'haṃ esaniyā pi sallassa esanāhetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyiṃ;
mn101:7.21: tassa me so bhisakko sallakatto sallaṃ abbyahi;
mn101:7.22: so 'haṃ sallassa pi abbyahanahetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyiṃ;
mn101:7.23: tassa me so bhisakko sallakatto agadaṅgāraṃ vaṇamukhe odahi;
mn101:7.24: so 'haṃ agadaṅgārassa pi vaṇamukhe odahanahetu dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyiṃ;
mn101:7.25: so 'mhi etarahi rūḷhena vaṇena saṃchavinā arogo sukhī serī sayaṃvasī yena kāmaṅgamo ti. --
mn101:8.1: Evam eva kho, āvuso Nigaṇṭhā, sace tumhe jāneyyātha:
mn101:8.2: Ahuvām' eva mayaṃ pubbe na nāhuvamhāti, jāneyyātha:
mn101:8.3: Akarām' eva mayaṃ pubbe pāpaṃ kammaṃ, na nākaramhāti; jāneyyātha:
mn101:8.4: Evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā pāpaṃ kammaṃ akaramhāti; jāneyyātha:
mn101:8.5: Ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjiretabbaṃ, ettakamhi vā dukkhe nijjiṇṇe sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatīti; jāneyyātha
mn101:8.6: diṭṭhe va dhamme akusalānaṃ kammānaṃ pahānaṃ, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadaṃ.
mn101:8.7: Evaṃ sante āyasmantānaṃ Nigaṇṭhānaṃ kallam assa veyyākaraṇāya:
mn101:8.8: Yaṃ kiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti, sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, sabban taṃ pubbekatahetu:
mn101:8.9: iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā vyantibhāvā, navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā, āyatiṃ anavassavo,
mn101:8.10: āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo, kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo, dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo, vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn101:9.1: Yasmā ca kho tumhe, āvuso Nigaṇṭhā, na jānātha:
mn101:9.2: Ahuvām' eva mayaṃ pubbe, na nāhuvamhāti, na jānātha:
mn101:9.3: Akarām' eva mayaṃ pubbe pāpaṃ kammaṃ, na nākaramāti; na jānātha:
mn101:9.4: Evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā pāpakammaṃ akaramhāti; na jānātha:
mn101:9.5: Ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ ettakaṃ vā dukkhaṃ nijjiretabbaṃ ettakamhi vā dukkhe nijjiṇṇe sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatīti, na jānātha
mn101:9.6: diṭṭhe va dhamme akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadaṃ, --
mn101:9.7: tasmā āyasmantānaṃ Nigaṇṭhānaṃ na kallam assa veyyākaranāya:
mn101:9.8: Yaṃ kiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti, sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, sabban taṃ pubbekatahetu;
mn101:9.9: iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā vyantibhāvā, navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā, āyatiṃ anavassavo,
mn101:9.10: āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo, kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo, dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo, vedanākkhayā sabban taṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn101:10.1: Evaṃ vutte, bhikkhave, te Nigaṇṭhā maṃ etad avocuṃ:
mn101:10.2: Nigaṇṭho, āvuso, Nāṭaputto sabbaññū sabbadassavī aparisesaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paṭijānāti:
mn101:10.3: Carato ca me tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitan ti.
mn101:10.5: Atthi kho vo, āvuso Nigaṇṭhā. pubbe pāpaṃ kammaṃ kataṃ. Taṃ imāya kaṭukāya dukkarakārīkāya nijjaretha;
mn101:10.6: yaṃ pan ettha etarahi kāyena saṃvutā vācāya saṃvutā manasā saṃvutā, taṃ āyatiṃ pāpassa kammassa akaraṇaṃ;
mn101:10.7: iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā vyantibhāvā, navānaṃ kammānam akaraṇā, āyatiṃ anavassavo,
mn101:10.8: āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo, kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo, dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo, vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn101:10.9: Tañ ca pan' amhakaṃ ruccati c' eva khamati ca tena c' amhā attamanā ti.
mn101:11.1: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ, bhikkhave, te Nigaṇṭhe etad avocaṃ:
mn101:11.2: Pañca kho ime, āvuso Nigaṇṭhā, dhammā diṭṭhe va dhamme dvidhā vipākā.
mn101:11.5: Ime kho, āvuso Nigaṇṭhā, pañca dhammā diṭṭhe va dhamme dvidhā vipākā.
mn101:11.6: Tatr' āyasmantānaṃ Nigaṇṭhānaṃ kā atītaṃse satthari saddhā, kā rūci, ko anussavo, ko ākāraparivitakko, kā diṭṭhinijjhānakhantīti?
mn101:11.7: Evaṃvādī kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, Nigaṇṭhesu na kiñci sahadhammikaṃ vādaparihāraṃ samanupassāmi.
mn101:12.1: Puna ca panāhaṃ , bhikkhave, te Nigaṇṭhe evaṃ vadāmi. --
mn101:12.3: Yasmiṃ vo samaye tippo upakkamo hoti tippaṃ padhānaṃ, tippā tamhi samaye opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyatha;
mn101:12.4: yasmiṃ pana vo samaye na tippo upakkamo hoti na tippaṃ padhānaṃ, na tippā tamhi samaye opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyathāti?
mn101:12.5: Yasmiṃ no, āvuso Gotama, samaye tippo upakkamo hoti tippaṃ padhānaṃ, tippā tamhi samaye opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyāma.
mn101:12.6: Yasmiṃ pana no samaye na tippo upakkamo hoti na tippaṃ padhānaṃ, na tippā tamhi samaye opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyāmāti.
mn101:13.1: Iti kir', āvuso Nigaṇṭhā, -- Yasmiṃ vo samaye tippo upakkamo hoti tippaṃ padhānaṃ, tippā tamhi samaye opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyatha;
mn101:13.2: yasmiṃ paṇa vo pana samaye na tippo upakkamo hoti na tippaṃ padhānaṃ, na tippā tamhi samaye opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyatha.
mn101:13.3: Evaṃ sante āyasmantānaṃ Nigaṇṭhānaṃ kallam assa veyyākaraṇāya:
mn101:13.4: Yam kiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti, sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, sabban taṃ pubbekatahetu;
mn101:13.5: iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā vyantibhāvā, navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā āyatiṃ anavassavo,
mn101:13.6: āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo, kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo, dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo, vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn101:14.1: Sace, āvuso Nigaṇṭhā, yasmiṃ vo samaye tippo upakkamo hoti tippaṃ padhānaṃ, tiṭṭheyy' eva tamhi samaye opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā;
mn101:14.2: yasmiṃ pana vo samaye na tippo upakkamo hoti na tibbaṃ padhānaṃ tiṭṭheyy' eva tasmiṃ samaye opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā.
mn101:14.3: Evaṃ sante āyasmantānaṃ Nigaṇṭhānaṃ kallam assa veyyākaraṇāya:
mn101:14.4: Yaṃ kiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvediti , sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, sabban taṃ pubbekatahetu;
mn101:15.1: Yasmā ca kho, āvuso Nigaṇṭhā, yasmiṃ pana vo samaye tippo upakkamo hoti tippaṃ padhānaṃ, tippā tamhi samaye opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyatha.
mn101:15.2: Yasmiṃ pana vo samaye na tippo upakkamo hoti na tippaṃ padhānaṃ, na tippaṃ tamhi samaye opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyatha.
mn101:15.3: Te tumhe sāmaṃ yeva opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyamānā avijjā aññāṇā sammohā vipaccetha:
mn101:15.4: Yaṃ kiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti, sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, sabban taṃ pubbekatahetu;
mn101:15.5: iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā vyantibhāvā, navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā, āyatiṃ anavassavo,
mn101:15.6: āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo, kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo, dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo, vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn101:15.7: Evaṃvādī pi kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, Nigaṇṭhesu na kiñci sahadhammikaṃ vādapaṭihāraṃ samanupassāmi.
mn101:16.1: Puna ca panāhaṃ, bhikkhave, te Nigaṇṭhe evaṃ vadāmi:--
mn101:16.2: Taṃ kim maññath ' āvuso Nigaṇṭhā? Yam idaṃ kammaṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā samparāyavedanīyaṃ hotūti labbham etan ti?
mn101:16.4: Yam pan' idaṃ kammaṃ samparāyavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ hotūti labbham etan ti?
mn101:17.1: Taṃ kim maññath', āvuso Nigaṇṭhā? Yam idaṃ kammaṃ sukhavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā dukkhavedanīyaṃ hotūti labbham etan ti?
mn101:17.3: Yaṃ pan' idaṃ kammaṃ dukkhavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā sukhavedanīyaṃ hotūti labbham etan ti?
mn101:18.1: Taṃ kim maññath', āvuso Nigaṇṭhā? Yam idaṃ kammaṃ paripakkavedanīyaṃ, tam upakkamena vā padhānena vā aparipakkavedanīyaṃ hotūti labbham etan ti?
mn101:18.3: Yaṃ pan' idaṃ kammaṃ aparipakkavedanīyaṃ taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā paripakkavedanīyaṃ hotūti labbham etan ti?
mn101:19.1: Taṃ kim maññath', āvuso Nigaṇṭhā? Yam idaṃ kammaṃ bahuvedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā appavedanīyaṃ hotūti labbham etan ti?
mn101:19.3: Yaṃ pan' idaṃ kammaṃ appavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā bahuvedanīyaṃ hotūti labbham etan ti?
mn101:20.1: Taṃ kim maññath', āvuso Nigaṇṭhā? Yam idaṃ kammaṃ vedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā avedanīyaṃ hotūti labbham etan ti?
mn101:20.3: Yaṃ pan' idaṃ kammaṃ avedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā vedanīyaṃ hotūti labbham etan ti?
mn101:21.1: Iti kir', āvuso Nigaṇṭhā, yam idaṃ kammaṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā samparāyavedanīyaṃ hotūti alabbham etaṃ; yam idam kammaṃ samparāyavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ hotūti alabbham etaṃ; yam p' idaṃ kammaṃ sukhavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā dukkhavedanīyaṃ hotūti alabbham etaṃ; yam p' idaṃ kammaṃ dukkhavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā sukhavedanīyaṃ hotūti alabbham etaṃ; yam p' idaṃ kammam paripakkavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā aparipakkavedanīyaṃ hotūti alabbham etaṃ; yam p' idam kammaṃ aparipakkavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā paripakkavedanīyaṃ hotūti alabbham etaṃ; yam p' idaṃ kammaṃ bahuvedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā appavedanīyaṃ hotūti alabbham etaṃ; yam p' idaṃ kammaṃ appavedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā bahuvedanīyaṃ hotūti alabbham etaṃ; yam p' idaṃ kammaṃ vedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā avedanīyaṃ hotūti alabbham etaṃ; yam p' idaṃ kammaṃ avedanīyaṃ, taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā vedanīyaṃ hotūti alabbham etaṃ.
mn101:21.2: Evaṃ sante āyasmantānaṃ Nigaṇṭhānaṃ aphalo upakkamo hoti aphalaṃ padhānaṃ.
mn101:22.2: evaṃvādīnaṃ, bhikkhave. Nigaṇṭhānaṃ dasa sahadhammikā vādānuvādā gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchanti.
mn101:22.3: Sace, bhikkhave, sattā pubbekatahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti,
mn101:22.4: addhā, bhikkhave, Nigaṇṭhā pubbedukkatakammakārino, yaṃ etarahi evarūpā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.
mn101:22.5: Sace, bhikkhave, sattā issaranimmānahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti,
mn101:22.6: addhā, bhikkhave, Nigaṇṭhā pāpakena issarena nimmitā, yaṃ etarahi evarūpā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.
mn101:22.7: Sace, bhikkhave, sattā saṅgatibhāvahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti,
mn101:22.8: addhā, bhikkhave, Nigaṇṭhā pāpasaṅgatikā, yaṃ etarahi evarūpā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.
mn101:22.9: Sace, bhikkhave, sattā abhijātihetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti,
mn101:22.10: addhā, bhikkhave, Nigaṇṭhā pāpābhijātikā yaṃ etarahi evarūpā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.
mn101:22.11: Sace, bhikkhave, sattā diṭṭhādhammupakkamahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti,
mn101:22.12: addhā, bhikkhave, Nigaṇṭhā pāpadiṭṭhadhammupakkamā, yaṃ etarahi evarūpā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.
mn101:22.13: Sace, bhikkhave, sattā pubbekatahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, gārayhā Nigaṇṭhā;
mn101:22.14: no ce sattā pubbekatahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, gārayhā Nigaṇṭhā.
mn101:22.15: Sace, bhikkhave, sattā issarinimmānahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, gārayhā Nigaṇṭhā;
mn101:22.16: no ce sattā issarinimmānahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, gārayhā Nigaṇṭhā.
mn101:22.17: Sace, bhikkhave, sattā saṅgatibhāvahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, gārayhā Nigaṇṭhā;
mn101:22.18: no ce sattā saṅgatibhāvahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, gārayhā Nigaṇṭhā.
mn101:22.19: Sace, bhikkhave, sattā abhijātihetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, gārayhā Nigaṇṭhā;
mn101:22.20: no ce sattā abhijātihetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, gārayhā Nigaṇṭhā.
mn101:22.21: Sace, bhikkhave, sattā diṭṭhadhammupakkamahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, gārayhā Nigaṇṭhā;
mn101:22.22: no ce sattā diṭṭhadhammupakkamahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, gārayhā Nigaṇṭhā.
mn101:22.24: evaṃvādīnaṃ, bhikkhave, Nigaṇṭhānaṃ ime dasa sahadhammikā vādānuvādā gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchanti.
mn101:22.25: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, aphalo upakkamo hoti aphalaṃ padhānaṃ.
mn101:23.1: Kathañ ca, bhikkhave, saphalo upakkamo hoti saphalaṃ padhānaṃ?
mn101:23.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na heva anaddha bhūtaṃ attānaṃ dukkhena addhabhāveti, dhammikañ ca sukhaṃ na paricajjati, tasmiñ ca sukhe anadhimucchito hoti.
mn101:23.4: Imassa kho me dukkhanidānassa saṃkhāraṃ padahato saṃkhārappadhānā virāgo hoti; imassa pana me dukkhanidānassa ajjhupekkhato upekham bhāvayato virāgo hotīti.
mn101:23.5: So yassa khvāssa dukkhanidānassa saṃkhāraṃ padahato saṃkhārappadhānā virāgo hoti, saṃkhāraṃ tattha padahati;
mn101:23.6: yassa pana dukkhanidānassa ajjhupekkhato upekham bhāvayato virāgo hoti, upekhaṃ tattha bhāveti
mn101:23.7: tassa dukkhanidānassa saṃkhāraṃ padahato saṃkhārappadhānā virāgo hoti. --
mn101:23.8: Evam pi 'ssa taṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ hoti,
mn101:23.9: tassa tassa dukkhanidānassa ajjhupekkhato upekhaṃ bhāvayato virāgo hoti,
mn101:23.10: evam pi 'ssa taṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ hoti.
mn101:24.1: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, puriso itthiyā sāratto paṭibaddhacitto tibbacchando tibbāpekho.
mn101:24.2: So taṃ itthiṃ passeyya aññena purisena saddhim santiṭṭhantiṃ sallapantiṃ sañjagghantiṃ saṃhasantiṃ.
mn101:24.4: Api nu tassa purisassa , amuṃ itthiṃ disvā aññena purisena saddhiṃ santiṭṭhantiṃ sallapantiṃ sañjagghantiṃ saṃhasantiṃ, uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā ti?
mn101:24.7: Amu hi, bhante, puriso amussā itthiyā sāratto paṭibaddhacitto tibbacchando tibbāpekko;
mn101:24.8: tasmā taṃ itthiṃ disvā aññena purisena saddhiṃ santiṭṭhantiṃ sallapantiṃ sañjagghantiṃ saṃhasantiṃ, uppajjanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā ti.
mn101:25.1: Atha kho bhikkhave, tassa purisassa evam assa:
mn101:25.2: Ahaṃ kho amussā itthiyā sāratto paṭibaddhacitto tibbacchando tibbāpekho;
mn101:25.3: tassa me amuṃ itthiṃ disvā aññena purisena saddhiṃ santiṭṭhantiṃ sallapantiṃ sañjagghantiṃ saṃhasantiṃ uppajjanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā;
mn101:25.4: yan nūnāhaṃ yo me amussā itthiyā chandarāgo taṃ pajaheyyan ti.
mn101:25.5: So yo amussā itthiyā chandarāgo taṃ pajaheyya.
mn101:25.6: So taṃ itthiṃ passeyya aparena samayena aññena purisena saddhiṃ santiṭṭhantiṃ sallapantiṃ sañjagghantiṃ saṃhasantiṃ.
mn101:25.8: Api nu tassa purisassa amuṃ iṭṭhiṃ disvā aññena purisena saddhiṃ santiṭṭhantiṃ sallapantiṃ sañjagghantiṃ saṃhasantiṃ, uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā ti?
mn101:25.11: Amu hi, bhante, puriso amussā itthiyā vītarāgo;
mn101:25.12: tasmā taṃ itthiṃ disvā aññena purisena saddhiṃ santiṭṭhantiṃ sallapantiṃ sañjagghantiṃ saṃhasantiṃ na uppajjanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā ti.
mn101:26.1: Evam eva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na heva anaddhabhūtaṃ attānaṃ dukkhena addhabhāveti, dhammikañ ca sukhaṃ na paricajati tasmiñ ca sukhe anadhimucchito hoti.
mn101:26.3: Imassa kho me dukkhanidānassa saṃkhāraṃ padahato saṃkhārappadhānā virāgo hoti. Imassa pana me dukkhanidānassa ajjhupekkhato upekhabhāvayato virāgo hotīti.
mn101:26.4: So yassa khvāssa dukkhanidānassa saṃkhāraṃ padahato saṃkhārappadhānā virāgo hoti, saṃkhāraṃ tattha padahati;
mn101:26.5: yassa pan' assa dukkhanidānassa ajjhupekkhato upekhaṃ bhāvayato virāgo hoti, upekhaṃ tattha bhāveti,
mn101:26.6: tassa tassa dukkhanidānassa saṃkhāraṃ padahato saṃkhārappadhānā virāgo hoti,
mn101:26.7: evam pi 'ssa taṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ hoti,
mn101:26.8: tassa tassa dukkhanidānassa ajjhupekkhato upekhaṃ bhāvayato virāgo hoti,
mn101:26.10: Evam pi, bhikkhave, saphalo upakkamo hoti saphalaṃ padhānaṃ.
mn101:27.1: Puna ca paraṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn101:27.2: Yathāsukhaṃ kho me viharato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyanti;
mn101:27.3: dukkhāya pana me attānaṃ padahato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti.
mn101:27.6: tassa dukkhāya attānaṃ padahato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti.
mn101:27.7: So na aparena samayena dukkhāya attānaṃ padahati.
mn101:27.9: Yassa hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthāya dukkhāya attānaṃ padaheyya, svāssa attho abhinipphanno hoti,
mn101:27.10: tasmā na aparena samayena dukkhāya attānaṃ padahati.
mn101:28.1: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, usukāro tejanaṃ dvīsu alātesu ātāpeti paritāpeti ujuṃ karoti kammaniyaṃ.
mn101:29.1: Yato kho, bhikkhave, usukārassa tejanaṃ dvīsu alātesu ātāpitaṃ hoti paritāpitaṃ hoti ujuṃ kataṃ kammaniyaṃ, na so taṃ aparena samayena usukāro tejanaṃ dvīsu alātesu ātāpeti paritāpeti ujuṃ karoti kammaniyaṃ.
mn101:29.3: Yassa hi so, bhikkhave, atthāya usukāro tejanam dvīsu atālesu ātāpeyya paritapeyya ujuṃ kareyya kammaniyaṃ, svāssa attho abinipphanno hoti;
mn101:29.4: tasmā na aparena samayena usukāro ca tejanaṃ dvīsu alāpesu ātāpeti paritāpeti ujuṃ karoti kammaniyaṃ. --
mn101:29.5: Evam eva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn101:29.6: Yathāsukhaṃ kho me viharato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyanti,
mn101:29.7: dukkhāya pana me attānaṃ padahato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti;
mn101:29.10: tassa dukkhāya attānaṃ padahato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti.
mn101:29.11: So na aparena samayena dukkhāya attānaṃ padahati.
mn101:29.13: Yassa hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthāya dukkhāya attānaṃ padaheyya, svāssa attho abhinipphanno hoti,
mn101:29.14: tasmā na aparena samayena dukkhāya attānaṃ padahati.
mn101:29.15: Evam pi, bhikkhave, saphalo upakkamo hoti saphalaṃ padhānaṃ.

mn101:38.1: So ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
